name: smwmusic-rap-jam-volume-one-entering-chicago-tournament
title: Rap Jam: Volume One - Entering Chicago Tournament
description:
Ambient calm hip hop music that plays when you're about to enter the Chicago tournament, the first tournament in Rap Jam.

Had to optimize and loop the chordal sample in order for SMW samples to fit in.

If the chordal instrument cutting off midway (like it did in the original) bothers you a bit, use the slightly modified version.
